Title: MemorySmith.Agent — HTN Planner and Task Library
Content:
HtnPlanner (Agent.Planning) implements IPlanner. PlanAsync: tries decomposer-registry routing first; if none matches, decomposes by task-library name match then phase-by-phase; if still no actions, uses LLM fallback (Sprint 55). ReplanAsync: full restart using await/try-catch (NOT ContinueWith — see Phase 3 council fix). Returns ReplanResult.Success/Failure (TSK-0104).

## HtnTaskLibrary — 11 Named Task Methods (Agent.Planning/HtnTaskLibrary.cs)

Registered in the `_methods` dictionary (StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase):

| Method | Actions | Notes |
|--------|---------|-------|
| GatherWood | GatherItemDecompose(OakLogSpec) | Delegates to internal GatherItemDecompose with OakLogSpec |
| FindTree | GetStatus | Stub — placeholder for future tree-finding logic |
| MineWood | MineBlock(oak_log, N) + MineBlock(birch_log, N) | Hardcoded block IDs; direct mining without item registry |
| Collect | GetStatus | Stub — placeholder for item collection |
| SurviveNight | GetStatus | Stub — delegates to SurviveNightGoalDecomposer at goal level |
| FindShelter | GetStatus | Stub — phase of SurviveNightGoal |
| LightArea | GetStatus | Stub — phase of SurviveNightGoal |
| WaitForSunrise | GetStatus | Stub — phase of SurviveNightGoal |
| Wander | Wander(radius, maxDistanceFromSpawn) + GetStatus | Configurable radius (default 20), maxDist (default 100) |
| Explore | Wander + GetStatus + Wander + GetStatus | Double exploration cycle, maxDist configurable |
| FindFlatArea | FindFlatArea(radius, minFlatArea) + GetStatus | Configurable radius (default 20), minArea (default 25) |

## Key Decomposition Methods (called directly by HtnPlanner or decomposers)

| Method | Purpose | Details |
|--------|---------|---------|
| DecomposeBuild | BuildGoal decomposition (public, ~300 lines) | Creative: BlueprintExecutor + per-block checkpoint filtering (TSK-0125). Survival: material gather → torch coal pre-gather → iron smelt pre-gather → BuildCraftingChain (sorted via CraftingChainOrder) → PlaceBlock loop. FindFlatArea emitted when no origin (requireOrigin=true). Retry gate: FlatAreaRetryRadius=48 (Sprint 36 P0-C). Accepts BuildOrigin value object (TSK-0107). |
| DecomposeCraftItem | CraftItemGoal decomposition (public) | Pre-gather iron ingots (iron tools via IronIngotRequirements dict), cobblestone (stone tools via CobblestoneRequirements dict), logs (planks). AddCraftingTableIfNeeded helper extracts crafting-table bootstrap. Creative mode: /give fallback. Emits CraftItem + GetStatus. |
| DecomposeSmeltItem | SmeltGoal decomposition (public, Sprint 44) | Pre-gather coal (fuel), pre-gather input block. Emits SmeltItem + GetStatus. Uses SmeltableMapping for input/output resolution. |
| DecomposeGatherItem | Gather-item decomposition (public) | Emits MineBlock actions for each SourceBlock in the ItemSpec. Calculates blocks-per-pass. Supports yield-aware gathering (e.g. stone→cobblestone). Sprint 38 P0-A: GetStatus removed from end of sequence (no longer needed). |
| GatherItemDecompose | Internal gather-item helper | Core gather logic: iterates SourceBlocks, emits MineBlock actions in batches. Used by GatherWood, MineWood, and DecomposeGatherItem. Accounts for variable smeltable:non-smeltable blocks. |

## LLM Fallback

Sprint 55: When HtnPlanner.PlanAsync produces zero actions from all decomposition paths (no decomposer, no task-method match, no phase match), it calls `TryLlmFallbackAsync` which:

1. Checks `_llm.IsAvailable` — skips if provider unavailable
2. Builds a prompt with: goal name, description, phases, bot position/health/gameMode, available tool names (from ToolDispatcher.RegisteredNames)
3. Calls `_llm.CompleteAsync(prompt, "", ct)`
4. Parses response as JSON array of `{tool, args}` objects via `ParseLlmActions`
5. Returns actions or null on failure

Sprint 58 Wave C (TSK-0323): Made async — was sync-over-async blocking the dispatch loop for 15s+.

## GoalFactory Registration Details

GoalFactory (Agent.Planning/GoalFactory.cs) maps goal name strings to IGoal instances:

### Synchronous Creators (static Dictionary)
```csharp
Creators = new Dictionary<string, Func<IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object?>?, IGoal>>
{
    ["GatherWood"]   = p => new GatherWoodGoal(GetInt(p, "count", 10)),
    ["SurviveNight"] = _ => new SurviveNightGoal(),
};
```

### Async Prefixes (CreateAsync)
| Prefix | Result | Async Lookup | Fallback |
|--------|--------|-------------|----------|
| GatherItem:{itemId} | GenericGatherGoal | IItemRegistry.GetAsync | CommonMinecraftBlocks.DirectMineBlocks |
| Build:{blueprintId} | BuildGoal | IBlueprintRepository.GetAsync + BlueprintParser.Parse | null |
| CraftItem:{itemId} | CraftItemGoal | None (direct constructor) | N/A |
| SmeltItem:{inputItem} | SmeltGoal | None (direct constructor) | N/A |
| PlaceBlock:{item} | PlaceBlockGoal | None (direct constructor) | N/A |

### RegisteredGoals Property
Returns: `["GatherWood", "SurviveNight", "GatherItem:{itemId}", "Build:{blueprintId}", "CraftItem:{itemId}", "SmeltItem:{inputItem}", "PlaceBlock:{item}"]`

## Crafting Constants

| Constant | Value | Purpose |
|----------|-------|---------|
| TorchesPerCraft | 4 | Vanilla: 1 stick + 1 coal → 4 torches |
| PlanksPerLog | 4 | Vanilla: 1 log → 4 planks |
| PreflightFlatAreaRadius | 30 | Default FindFlatArea radius when no origin set |
| PreflightFlatAreaMin | 25 | Minimum qualifying flat area (cells) |
| FlatAreaRetryRadius | 48 | Retry radius when initial scan returns area=0 |
| MaxSteps (TaskSequenceGoal) | 5 | Maximum steps in a compound command chain |

### Crafting Chain Order
Sorted list of items emitted in order by BuildCraftingChain:
`[oak_planks, birch_planks, ..., crafting_table, stick, oak_slab, oak_stairs, oak_door, oak_fence, oak_fence_gate, chest, wooden_pickaxe, wooden_axe, wooden_shovel, stone_pickaxe, stone_axe, stone_shovel, stone_sword]`

### Requires Crafting Table
Items in the crafting chain that need a crafting_table: slabs, stairs, doors, fences, gates, chest, all wooden/stone/iron tools.

### Iron Ingot Requirements
Pre-gather dict: iron_pickaxe=3, iron_axe=3, iron_shovel=1, iron_sword=2, iron_hoe=2, iron_helmet=5, iron_chestplate=8, iron_leggings=7, iron_boots=4.

### Cobblestone Requirements
Pre-gather dict: stone_pickaxe=3, stone_axe=3, stone_shovel=1, stone_sword=2, stone_hoe=2.
